gdp_real.label: Real GDP, constant prices (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.KN)

policy_rate.label: One-year loan prime rate (BIS central bank policy rates, M.CN)

debt_gdp.label: General government gross debt, % of GDP (IMF WEO)

deficit.label: General government net lending/borrowing, % of GDP (IMF WEO)

current_account.label: Current account balance, % of GDP (World Bank)

fdi.label: FDI net inflows, % of GDP (World Bank)

unemployment.label: Unemployment rate, ILO modelled estimate, % of labour force (World Bank SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS)

exports.label: Exports of goods, FOB (IMF international trade in goods, XG), converted to yuan at each month's exchange rate

imports.label: Imports of goods, CIF (IMF international trade in goods, MG), converted to yuan at each month's exchange rate

trade_balance.label: Trade balance, goods, exports FOB less imports CIF (IMF international trade in goods), converted to yuan at each month's exchange rate

gdp_level.label: GDP, current prices, not seasonally adjusted (OECD quarterly national accounts, B1GQ)

gdp_growth.label: Real GDP growth, change on previous quarter, seasonally adjusted (OECD quarterly national accounts, B1GQ)

gdp_growth_yoy.label: Real GDP growth, change on same quarter a year earlier (OECD quarterly national accounts, B1GQ)

cpi.label: CPI, all items, YoY (OECD prices database)

business_confidence.label: Business confidence indicator, LT avg = 100 (OECD BCICP)
